fields.label: Daily API Call Cap
fields.description: Maximum GST portal API calls per day. 0 = no cap.

fields.label: Mock GST Portal
fields.description: Testing only. Uses the sample data from the Adaequare collection instead of the real portal: OTP 123456 is accepted and sync imports 3 sample notices with a small PDF each. Never enable in production.

fields.label: Require business approval
fields.description: On: a business created by a GST User (LitWatch app) waits as Pending until approved in Frappe; its GSTINs can't request an OTP until then. Off: new businesses are approved straight away. Pending businesses are not approved automatically when this is turned off.

fields.label: Require GSTIN approval
fields.description: On: after the OTP is verified a GSTIN waits as Awaiting verification until approved in Frappe. Off: a verified GSTIN is connected (active) straight away. GSTINs already waiting stay waiting when this is turned off.

fields.label: Send account email
fields.description: When a GST User is created (by the team, from a lead, or by registration), email the acknowledgement with a set-password link.

fields.label: LitWatch app URL
fields.description: Where users sign in, e.g. https://app.litwatch.in. Used in emails and registration links. Empty = this site's URL.

fields.label: Registration page path
fields.description: Path of the registration form in the LitWatch app; the link is <app URL><path>?token=...

fields.label: Default reply reminders (days before due)
fields.description: Used when a user's Notification Setting has no deadline reminders. Comma-separated days.
